scope: Exact declared imports extracted from 10 high-risk CoreSpirit compiler/runtime/editor files. This is a targeted subgraph, not the full CoreSpirit import graph.
interpretation: importForm records TypeScript source syntax (import type versus value-or-mixed syntax); a value-syntax import may still be erased by TypeScript when imported symbols are only types.
findings: frontends.ts registers PineV6Frontend as a direct value import.
pineV6Frontend.ts imports frontends.ts with import type, so the observed two-way source reference is not a two-way runtime import.
semanticAnalyzer.ts directly imports pineBuiltinRegistry.ts using value-or-mixed syntax.
runtime.ts directly imports Pine math, string and color adapters using value-or-mixed syntax.

ir.ts imports 18 optional metadata/report types from optimizer, planner, compiler pipeline, specialized plan, research and policy modules; all 18 declarations use import type. This is compile-time coupling, not a runtime side-effect edge.
languageService.ts imports the Pine feature registry for editor completions.
limitations: Only these 10 high-risk files are included; use the complete source-inventory.json for the full tracked path list.
No dependency-cycle or bundler-graph analysis is claimed by this source-import extraction.
